question_text: To qualify for the DILG Seal of Good Local Governance, an LGU must meet all of the following conditions: (1) full disclosure of financial statements, (2) no adverse COA audit opinion for the past two years, (3) compliance with the full disclosure policy, and (4) at least 85% local revenue collection efficiency. Which of the following LGUs qualifies for the seal?

options.text: LGU A: Full disclosure of financial statements, adverse COA opinion in one of the past two years, compliance with full disclosure policy, 90% revenue collection efficiency.
LGU B: Full disclosure of financial statements, no adverse COA opinion, compliance with full disclosure policy, 80% revenue collection efficiency.
LGU C: Full disclosure of financial statements, no adverse COA opinion, non-compliance with full disclosure policy, 88% revenue collection efficiency.
LGU D: Full disclosure of financial statements, no adverse COA opinion, compliance with full disclosure policy, 86% revenue collection efficiency.
